card.name: First letter of a split capitalized word
card.fires_on: A single capital letter or short piece that starts a word which is split up, often in all-caps headings such as RESPECT FOR HUMAN RIGHTS or DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE. Also fires on the start of a name or term, such as Dutchess or ETS.

modes.label: All-caps headings
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized heading word, after a word like FOR, AND or OF.

modes.description: The first piece of a place name, acronym or lowercase word broken into parts in running text.
